SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Nat. c.]
Gnawing and pressure in stomach, with distension and "gone", weak feeling about 10 or 11 A. M., > from eating.
Stomach weak and easily disordered.
Heaviness and pressure in stomach ; nausea ; frequent hiccough.
Violent pressure in stomach after dinner and breakfast.
Pit of stomach sensitive to touch and when talking.
Cramp in stomach, pressing, drawing, cutting pain.
Depressed and exceedingly irritable, particularly after dinner ; hypochondriasis ; > as food passes out of stomach into duodenum and down into bowels ; averse to society, even to his own family ; indigestion, < after vegetable diet, particularly starchy foods ; sour eructations ; waterbrash ; retching in morning ; spasmodic contraction of œsophagus and stomach, with little or nothing coming to mouth ; copious salivation ; abdomen hard and swollen, especially after eating ; accumulation of flatus, fetid when passed ; griping colic just after a meal ; stool difficult to expel, though not hard. θ Indigestion.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Nat. c.]
Violent, sharp stitches in right hypochondriac region, followed by griping in lower abdomen.
Stitches in left hypochondrium ; < after drinking very cold water.
Stitches in hepatic and splenic regions. θ Chronic hepatitis.
Violent stitches in region of spleen.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Nat. c.]
Colic with constriction around stomach ; contraction of navel, hardness of integuments of abdomen.
Hard, bloated, swollen abdomen.
Accumulation of flatus ; loud rumbling ; swellings here and there as from incarcerated wind.
Flatus changing place and causing pain.
Distension of abdomen, especially after eating.
Griping in abdomen like colic, immediately after eating.
Pressure in lower abdomen, extending to genitals, as if everything in abdomen would fall out and menses come.
Itch-like eruption on lower part of abdomen.
Swelling (generally painful) of glands of groin and axilla.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Nat. c.]
Passes much sour smelling or fetid flatus ; feces escape.
Stools : yellow ; soft or watery, with violent, sudden urging and tenesmus ; watery, yellow, discharged with gush ; < from milk or after eating and from taking cold ; spotted with blood ; sour smelling ; yellow, with burning and tenesmus ; frequent, ineffectual urging, alternately with liquid stools ; soft, preceded by colic.
Discharge of blood during stool.
Yellow substance, like pulp of an orange, in stool ; climacteric period.
Difficult evacuation of stool that was not hard ; was obliged to make great effort before it could be discharged.
Insufficient stool, with tenesmus, followed by burning in eyes and urethra ; great sexual excitement. θ Constipation.
Constipation, alternating with soft and liquid stools.
Before stool : cutting ; strong urging ; severe colic with rumbling in abdomen.
During stool : tenesmus ; burning and cutting in anus and rectum ; sexual excitement.
After stool ; pain in rectum.
Itching in anus.
Tapeworm with stool ; itching creeping in anus.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Nat. c.]
Pressure in region of bladder.
Frequent desire to urinate, discharge scanty or copious.
Nocturnal, involuntary micturition.
Urine : dark yellow, fetid, sour, or like horse's urine ; deposits a mucous sediment like well water, when she must go often, pain mostly in right leg as if veins were bruised.
Burning in urethra during and after micturition.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Nat. c.]
Increased sexual desire ; priapism.
Nocturnal erections and pollutions, or emissions without erections.
Incomplete coition, short erection, speedy emission.
Chronic hypertrophy of prostate, small and painless, only detected by physical examination suggested by discharge of prostatic fluid at stool and when urinating.
Straining and tenesmus, with a voluptuous sensation in genitals.
Prostatorrhœa after urinating and after difficult stool.
Inflammation, swelling and easy excoriation of prepuce and glans penis.
Soreness between scrotum and thighs.
Heaviness and drawing in testicles ; testicles feel bruised.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Nat. c.]
Pressure in hypogastrium as if everything would come out ; indurated cervix and ill shaped os.
Bearing down as if everything would come out ; melancholy ; oversensitive to music ; backache ; heaviness, < sitting, > moving ; bruised pain over back at night, tension, boring from tip of left scapula through ; skin dry, rough.
Passive congestion of uterus, causing pulsation there during and after coitus, due to extra influx of blood caused by sexual erethism.
Pressure as if uterus would protrude.
Motion as from fetus in uterus.
Moles in uterus.
Menses : too early and long lasting ; preceded by drawing in nape of neck and headache ; with tearing headache, distended abdomen in morning, > by diarrhœa ; nervous, cannot bear music ; < in a thunderstorm.
Metrorrhagia.
Deficient menstruation in adult females.
Dysmenorrhœa ; sterility.
Congenital defective growth of anterior vaginal wall, with ill shaped os.
Discharge of mucus from vagina after an embrace, causing sterility.
Profuse leucorrhœa, after frequent attacks of colic, with writhing about umbilicus.
Leucorrhœa, with frequent copious urination.
Leucorrhœa thick, yellow, putrid, ceasing after urinating.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Nat. c.]
Expels moles, prevents false conception.
Labor pains weak or accompanied by anguish and sweat, with desire to be rubbed.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Nat. c.]
Hoarseness, with roughness of chest, coryza, chilliness and scraping, painful cough.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Nat. c.]
Dyspnœa and shortness of breath from tension of chest.
   

COUGH. [27] [Nat. c.]
Cough : dry, with stopped catarrh ; violent, dry, < when entering a warm room ; short, with rattling in chest ; with rumbling, incarcerated flatus ; with salty, purulent, greenish sputa.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Nat. c.]
Pressing stitches in chest.
Burning soreness in right mid chest ; loose cough, no sputum ; coldness between scapulæ, seems unable to give any exact voluntary statement ; pain in right rhomboid muscle when sewing or exercising, and in damp weather ; moves to opposite side sometimes.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Nat. c.]
Painful cracking in region of heart.
Violent, anxious palpitation of heart when ascending and at night when lying on left side.
Burning and distress along spine, with palpitation ; thinks he has heart disease.
Palpitation : woke her at night, while lying on left side ; on going up stairs ; prevents lying on side.
Pulse excited at night, with ebullitions.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Nat. c.]
Chilliness in one (left) side of thorax.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Nat. c.]
Cervical glands swollen.
Goitre pressing pain ; round, hard swelling on upper r. part of gland.
Stiffness of neck.
Cracking of cervical vertebræ on moving head.
Rigidity and drawing between scapulæ in open air, or in back, extending as far as anus, in paroxysms and terminating in a stitch when sitting or lying.
Stitch in back, sometimes as far as left side of chest, evening and night.
Backache ; violent after walking.
Stitches in small of back while sitting.
Tingling (formication) in back.
Pustules on small of back.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Nat. c.]
Rheumatic pain of shoulder, arms and elbows, with weakness of arms.
Pressing pain on shoulders.
Has to stretch arms, with anxiety.
Twitches and twitching sensation in arms and fingers on taking hold of anything.
Drawing pain in elbow.
Warts on arms and backs of hands ; painful to touch.
Cutting pain in hands.
Trembling of hands, morning.
Contraction of fingers.
Swelling of hands in afternoon.
Eczema, skin of dorsa of hands rough, dry and chapped.
Jerking sensation in finger joints.
White bulla, with red areola on index finger.
Panaritium.
